title: Goat OS stg — Mobile (goatos-android)
description: Network latency, funnel conversion, and crash-free rate for goatos-android per OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.5/2.6. LIVE-INSTANCE CAVEAT (checked via /api/datasources on this exact Grafana): only 'Google Cloud Monitoring' (stackdriver) and 'BigQuery' datasources are provisioned — there is no Postgres datasource (analytics.* rollup tables), so funnel/journey/crash-free panels are placeholders naming the missing datasource rather than broken queries against it. App-start, screen render, crash reporting, and GA4 event capture live in Firebase Performance/Crashlytics/Analytics consoles directly (native SDKs, not OTel) and are out of Grafana's scope by design. Network round-trip (OTel-Android OkHttp interceptor) has NOT been added to apps/goatos-android yet (grepped, no OTel/OkHttp interceptor code exists) — its panel below is a correctly-shaped query for the documented http.client.request.duration OTel semantic-convention metric, which will 404 until that interceptor ships, same treatment as every other pending-telemetry panel in this dashboard set.

panels.title: Network round-trip p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: http.client.request.duration -> prometheus.googleapis.com/http_client_request_duration_seconds/histogram, filtered to service.name="goatos-android". NOT YET emitted — apps/goatos-android has no OTel/OkHttp interceptor wired (OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.5 describes it as a planned addition). Query is correct-shape and will populate once the interceptor ships. p95 stands in for the requested p90 (Cloud Monitoring has no p90 aligner, verified live).

panels.title: Analytics-rollup job run duration by outcome
panels.description: kernel.analytics_rollup.run.duration (Cloud Run Job, GA4/Crashlytics BigQuery aggregation + Postgres upsert), label outcome (succeeded/failed/skipped). 'skipped' is the expected exit-0 path today, since GOATOS_GA4_EXPORT_DATASET is unset in stg until the Firebase GA4 BigQuery export is manually linked (infra/envs/stg/analytics_rollup.tf).

panels.title: Analytics rows written (24h)
panels.description: kernel.analytics_rollup.rows_written — rows upserted into analytics.* Postgres tables per run. A flat zero for an extended period, once the job is enabled, means the rollup is running but finding nothing new to write (check GA4 export linkage).

panels.title: Journey, funnel, crash-free (pending Postgres analytics datasource)
Login -> submit journey duration p50/p90/p99 — needs Postgres analytics datasource

options.content: **Needs a Postgres analytics datasource** (`analytics.journey_daily`, sourced from Firebase Performance app-start traces rolled up by the analytics-rollup Cloud Run Job). Not a GMP/OTel metric — app-start/journey timing lives in Firebase Performance, exported via GA4->BigQuery, then rolled into Cloud SQL `analytics.*` per OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.6. This Grafana instance has no Postgres datasource provisioned today (only Cloud Monitoring + BigQuery — verified via `/api/datasources`). Once added (`infra/grafana/provisioning/datasources/datasources.yaml` already declares the shape under uid `postgres-analytics`), query: `SELECT event_date AS time, p50_ms/1000.0, p90_ms/1000.0, p99_ms/1000.0 FROM analytics.journey_daily WHERE tenant_id = $tenant AND journey_key = 'login_to_submit' AND $__timeFilter(event_date)`.

panels.title: Crash-free session rate (24h) — needs Postgres analytics datasource

options.content: **Needs a Postgres analytics datasource.** Sourced from `analytics.crash_daily`, a rollup of the Crashlytics BigQuery export. SLO target 99.5% (green), 98% (amber), else red. Query once live: `SELECT crash_free_sessions_pct FROM analytics.crash_daily WHERE tenant_id = $tenant AND event_date = (SELECT max(event_date) FROM analytics.crash_daily WHERE tenant_id = $tenant) ORDER BY app_version DESC LIMIT 1`.

panels.title: Funnel conversion: login -> bootstrap -> drive-open -> scan -> vaccination-capture -> submit — needs Postgres analytics datasource

options.content: **Needs a Postgres analytics datasource.** Rolled up from Firebase Analytics (GA4) daily BigQuery export into `analytics.funnel_daily`, keyed on the `AnalyticsEvents` funnel steps (docs/observability/TELEMETRY_GUARDRAILS.md + OBSERVABILITY_DESIGN.md section 2.5): login -> bootstrap -> drive-open -> scan -> vaccination-capture -> submit. Query once live: `SELECT step_key, step_index, users, ROUND(100.0 * conversions / NULLIF(users,0), 1) AS conversion_pct FROM analytics.funnel_daily WHERE tenant_id = $tenant AND funnel_key = 'goatos_mobile_core' AND event_date = CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY step_index`. An alternative BigQuery-datasource-only path exists (querying `goatos_stg_analytics_rollup`'s working tables directly, or the GA4 export dataset once `var.ga4_export_dataset_id` is linked in `infra/envs/stg/analytics_rollup.tf`) but is a per-load BigQuery scan and intentionally NOT the default per section 2.6's cost-aware design — Postgres stays the primary path even once available.
